references.text: Twelve leaders, one from each tribe, were appointed to represent the tribes of Israel, as here where each leader gives his staff.
The leaders of Israel, heads of their ancestral houses, the tribal chiefs who were in charge of those registered, brought their offerings.
God commands Moses to collect a staff from each tribe, and Aaron's staff is to represent the tribe of Levi.
An overview of the fathers' houses and the organization of the tribes in Israel, which forms the basis for representation through twelve staffs.
Aaron's staff was placed back as a sign against the rebels, confirming his selection among the tribes.
Aaron's staff that sprouted is mentioned as part of the ark of the covenant, testifying to this event with the staffs.
